summary: Applyflow is a Sydney-headquartered SaaS company building recruitment websites, career sites and job boards, with 200+ clients and presence in the UK and US. It was bought out of its listed parent by the acting CEO in May 2024 and announced a three-year Qantas Group partnership in Jan 2026. Head of Finance Sandie Royle describes herself as the only person in the finance team, responsible for everything from cashflow and month-end to invoicing and debt collection across three countries.
